name: klu-attend-plus
description: KLU Attend+ - Unofficial KLU Student Attendance Utility

scripts.dev: node ./scripts/ensure-port-free.mjs 3001 && concurrently -k -n WEB,API "npm run dev --workspace apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace packages/attendance-engine && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/attendance-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm install --workspace=packages/attendance-engine && npm install --workspace=apps/web && npm install --workspace=apps/api
